body:
View this post on the web at https://www.whytryai.com/p/sunday-rundown-87-deep-research

Happy Sunday, friends!
Welcome back to the weekly look at generative AI that covers the following:
Sunday Rundown (free): this week’s AI news + a fun AI fail.
Sunday Bonus (paid): a goodie for my paid subscribers [ https://substack.com/redirect/d8576fc2-4827-499f-97d2-7f4577fb65c0?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ].
Let’s get to it.
🗞️ AI news
Here are this week’s AI developments.
👩‍💻 AI releases
New stuff you can try right now:
Adobe’s new Acrobat AI Assistant can help people with contract work [ https://substack.com/redirect/4ce5992b-ac46-424b-b9a2-4e6d1b32d85e?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] by simplifying complex terms and spotting differences between agreements.
Google news:
The new Gemini 2.0 family is now available to everyone [ https://substack.com/redirect/0b2dde5e-c628-4f18-a26f-e005e7204f32?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ]:
Gemini 2.0 Flash and Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Experimental are available via the Gemini chatbot [ https://substack.com/redirect/58494679-3bde-4d6d-b6d7-b64d7c5ecf9a?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ].
Gemini 2.0 Flash Lite and Gemini 2.0 Pro Experimental are available via the Google AI Studio [ https://substack.com/redirect/611a77b3-4f37-46c5-abef-de513368cff6?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ]. 
Imagen 3 is now available through the Gemini API [ https://substack.com/redirect/d769a96c-a5ac-45b0-b3db-5c866a0ace5f?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ], so developers can incorporate it into apps and products. The rest of us can still use Imagen 3 for free via ImageFX [ https://substack.com/redirect/281c4e40-f577-4031-ad28-cae69630f99c?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] (Google Labs).
Hugging Face rolled out an open-source  [ https://substack.com/redirect/64a982a4-04ee-4e41-a982-0e8701d70dd1?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ]Deep Research [ https://substack.com/redirect/64a982a4-04ee-4e41-a982-0e8701d70dd1?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] agent [ https://substack.com/redirect/64a982a4-04ee-4e41-a982-0e8701d70dd1?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] that can autonomously browse the web and extract relevant information. (Sure, we didn’t have enough “Deep Research” products [ https://substack.com/redirect/7755b0be-a4ed-47a8-b2f8-47baebb1655c?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] to keep track of.)
Mistral AI gave its AI assistant ”le Chat” a major facelift [ https://substack.com/redirect/7b207fbe-c13a-47fd-ae02-6d064b04333c?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ], making it ultra-fast and improving its real-time browsing, image generation, and coding abilities.
OpenAI news:
Deep Research is a competent search agent [ https://substack.com/redirect/bb564923-9a57-4be9-9173-7880d20a2c27?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] powered by o3 that can conduct multistep research for complex topics. ChatGPT Pro accounts only for now. (I covered it and some alternatives [ https://substack.com/redirect/7755b0be-a4ed-47a8-b2f8-47baebb1655c?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ].)
o3-mini now shows more of its thinking [ https://substack.com/redirect/2cb88879-f882-4e1d-99c3-09370c1b385c?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] in a futile attempt to sound as endearing as DeepSeek-R1 [ https://substack.com/redirect/c18a9c24-71fa-44d5-a4e8-13384722aa63?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ].
Search inside ChatGPT is now available to everyone [ https://substack.com/redirect/2465b514-1a3f-418f-a4c0-930817c65e3b?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] without sign-up.
Pika Labs launched a fun Pikadditions [ https://substack.com/redirect/deaa66fd-4e26-4487-a7cf-380b6e08861d?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] feature [ https://substack.com/redirect/deaa66fd-4e26-4487-a7cf-380b6e08861d?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] that lets you insert anyone or anything into an existing video. (Everyone gets 15 free Pikadditions to try.)
PlayAI has a new text-to-speech model called  [ https://substack.com/redirect/243d0765-7841-4dbd-8e33-6c40a6a1b858?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ]”Dialog” [ https://substack.com/redirect/243d0765-7841-4dbd-8e33-6c40a6a1b858?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] that delivers emotive, humanlike speech and beats all competitors on human preference benchmarks.
🔬 AI research
Cool stuff you might get to try one day:
Bytedance showcased OmniHuman-1, an AI model that generates realistic videos [ https://substack.com/redirect/5350ec7c-778e-4b91-b2ce-38bd258ba2bb?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] from a single image and “motion signals” (e.g. audio).
Meta teased a VideoJAM [ https://substack.com/redirect/139ce9d1-a3a7-46f4-9d0e-6358c4ae5c57?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] framework [ https://substack.com/redirect/139ce9d1-a3a7-46f4-9d0e-6358c4ae5c57?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] that anchors AI video generation in realistic and coherent motion (a bit like what ControlNet [ https://substack.com/redirect/7af4c3b3-ac70-4f01-958e-ef936d479e89?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] does for images).
Singapore researchers introduced MatAnyone, a robust matting framework [ https://substack.com/redirect/4480a66e-9246-47f3-8390-7576be90f635?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] that can accurately extract subjects from videos while preserving fine details.
Topaz Labs unveiled Project Starlight, which turns old, low-quality videos [ https://substack.com/redirect/91f7d6cc-3af5-4eac-8654-84dc9bf67602?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] into sharp, high-resolution ones. (Apply for early access on X.)
📖 AI resources
Helpful AI tools and stuff that teaches you about AI:
“AI Voice Agents: 2025 Update [ https://substack.com/redirect/beb03d52-cc3c-43d8-ac4f-286ea4a9952d?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ]” [REPORT] - a look at the AI voice agent landscape and models by a16z.
“Constitutional Classifiers: Defending against universal jailbreaks [ https://substack.com/redirect/bfecf6f4-52b9-483e-8865-f715c13d914e?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ]” [RESEARCH PAPER] - a robust method to protect AI models by Anthropic.
“Deep Dive into LLMs like ChatGPT [ https://substack.com/redirect/5a8e2484-d05c-45d1-b504-0c3ef8ad5324?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ]” [VIDEO] - an accessible, exhaustive intro to LLMs for the general audience by the awesome Andrej Karpathy.
“Responsible AI Progress Report [ https://substack.com/redirect/aa448f3d-b048-4f62-b50d-9af68ccd42a8?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ]” [PDF] - Google’s approach to responsible AI.
“Spaces: The AI App Directory [ https://substack.com/redirect/fc292755-3a5d-4f3d-ab43-25569104640a?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ]” [DATABASE] - massive library of Hugging Face spaces with AI-powered search to help you find what you need.
🤦‍♂️ AI fail of the week
“Honey, I shrunk myself. No, I blew up the laptop. No, I…I don’t know anymore.”

💰 Sunday Bonus #47: Cross-check your work against multiple sources with NotebookLM
You already know that I love NotebookLM [ https://substack.com/redirect/04fc3d43-e5df-4cb7-9494-7c1bc860aff2?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ].
It made my go-to AI tools [ https://substack.com/redirect/82710eab-a66d-4896-9d16-23d717df409b?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] list, was featured in four Sunday Bonus segments,  [ https://substack.com/redirect/4ecae72b-9c9d-4547-b834-e14940493f31?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ]and has been steadily improving over time.
I often use NotebookLM to parse dozens of sources when doing research for a new article (like my “Gefion” guest post [ https://substack.com/redirect/57c588d7-fcd3-49f1-8186-eb5eacca108f?j=eyJ1IjoiNTY5N2E3In0.6xCD06MYERPXvVEZwM8uMA-ZMD_4DJOLrHN6gUOvWPM ] for AIport ).
Once my draft is finished, I normally use long-context LLMs like Gemini as my beta readers. But this week, I wanted to see if NotebookLM could help me review a draft and cross-check it against the background sources. 
Sadly, NotebookLM’s chat window is limited to about 300 words, so you can’t copy-paste the entire article you’re working on—it’ll gray out the “Submit” button if you do:
But there’s a rather reliable workaround to this limitation.
Let me show you the workflow and my go-to prompt for analyzing and cross-checking a draft against your research sources...
